title: Close auto-commits its own bee-store bookkeeping after a green close
action: After a GREEN, non-dry-run bee close (and only then): when the root is a git work tree and `git status --porcelain -- .bee` is non-empty, run path-scoped `git add -A -- .bee` then `git commit -m "Record <feature> close bookkeeping in the bee store" -- .bee`, and report the outcome in close's output as bookkeeping_commit: {committed: true, sha} | {committed: false, reason} (reasons: clean, config_off, not_a_repo, git_failed:<line>). Any git failure is ONE warning line in the text output and close's exit stays green (warn-never-block, same as the housekeeping doctrine). Config key close_commit_bookkeeping in .bee/config.json: absent or true = on; false = off; any non-boolean value is refused outright, never silently read as on (worktree_cleanup_on_merge precedent, phases.rs). A red close and --dry-run never commit. The commit must be path-scoped so unrelated user dirt and unrelated STAGED files are never swept (no-whole-tree-git law, friction rows 587-590). Update the close entry's help text in registry_payload.json (hand-maintained, no regen chain — knowledge-search ks-1 precedent) to name the auto-commit and the config opt-out. Tests TDD-style in the close driver's test module: (1) green close with dirty tracked .bee + unrelated dirty file commits only .bee paths, unrelated file untouched and uncommitted; (2) unrelated staged file stays staged and out of the commit; (3) config false = no commit, reason config_off; (4) non-boolean config value refused; (5) dry-run and red close never commit; (6) non-repo root = committed:false, reason not_a_repo, close still green.

truths: a green close in a repo with tracked .bee dirt leaves a commit touching only .bee paths
unrelated dirty and staged files are never swept into the bookkeeping commit
close exit code never changes because of a bookkeeping-commit failure

artifacts.substantive: bookkeeping auto-commit implementation plus its tests, no TODO stubs

trace.outcome: close auto-commits path-scoped .bee bookkeeping after green close; bookkeeping_commit reported; config opt-out with typed non-boolean refusal; 6 new tests
